findings: Form 4-E (form-4e) is finalised before 3 Proposal document(s) are final (lcc-certificate, form-4f, model-audit-opinion), so a qualification in them cannot be checked against its declaration (VOL-I 9.6 ('A Proposal that states ‘no deviations’ in Form 4-E while containing a qualification elsewhere in the Proposal shall be treated as non-responsive.')). If Form 4-E waited for all of them, it would finish on 2026-12-13 against its latest finish 2026-11-23: INFEASIBLE by 14 WD on the assumed durations (assemble-envelope-a, copies, deliver, fin-model-build, fin-model-freeze, form-4e, form-4f, lcc-certificate, lcc-ratio, model-audit-opinion, model-audit-review, model-auditor-appoint, seal-and-mark made late). How the cross-check is done (a later final read of every document, a different order, or a change of a lead time) is for a person (Legal, Bid manager); no duration, setting or dependency was changed.

A qualification of a commercial term of Volume V would have to be listed in Form 4-E (VOL-I 9.6: 'A Proposal that states ‘no deviations’ in Form 4-E while containing a qualification elsewhere in the Proposal shall be treated as non-responsive.'), which is placed in Envelope A (VOL-I 9.1(e)), where commercial information renders the Proposal non-responsive (VOL-I 6.2: 'The appearance of any price, rate, or other commercial information within Envelope A shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'); stated in Envelope B instead, it would be a conditional price (VOL-I 10.5: 'Any conditional price, price subject to adjustment other than as provided in Volume V, or alternative price shall render the Proposal non-responsive.'). Whether such a qualification can be made at all, and how Form 4-E words a deviation from a commercial term without commercial information, is for a person (Legal and Commercial); nothing is decided here.
